claims.claim_text: The indexed Milton V. Anastos is resolved at high confidence as the Harvard-trained Byzantine scholar associated with Harvard and Dumbarton Oaks.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact distinctive name and middle initial recur in the official NARA index, Harvard institutional history, a Harvard archival description, and a contemporary byline.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: the exact distinctive full name and middle initial align across the NARA index and multiple independent Harvard and contemporary sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The external records span 1936-1943 and establish a coherent pre-OSS scholarly chronology, but the accessible sources do not give an exact OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: The personnel file remains necessary to confirm the precise OSS assignment and transition chronology.
